description: Per-repo literature sub-index for cslib Temporal/Bimodal metalogic work (tasks 180, 444-446). Reference-only doc_id pointers into the global Literature/ repo.

entries.relevance: Burgess 'Axioms for tense logic I: Since and Until' — primary source for the Since/Until axiomatization (Burgess1982I citations in task 446).
Burgess 'Axioms for tense logic II: Time periods' — Burgess1982II disambiguation for task 446 citation hygiene.
Reynolds — the Burgess-Xu completeness result and IRR rule; directly relevant to base-BX completeness w.r.t. serial/ordered domains (task 445 obstruction).
Venema on Since/Until conservativity and completeness over classes of linear orders (task 445 conservativity).
Venema anti-axioms / conservativity questions for temporal logics.
Gabbay — irreflexivity rule and axiomatization of U,S over general linear time; completeness machinery for the domain-transfer question (task 445).
Blackburn et al., Modal Logic — Loewenheim-Skolem, bounded morphisms, model-theoretic transfer methods relevant to the countermodel-transport strategy (task 445).
Goldblatt, Logics of Time and Computation — completeness of temporal logics over ordered domains; frame classes and correspondence.
Rabinovich, 'A Proof of Kamp's Theorem' — expressive-completeness of Since/Until over the reals; central reference for structure-first MPL expressiveness arguments (task 464).
Caleiro, Viganò, Volpe — mosaic method for many-dimensional modal logics; structural completeness technique supporting the structure-first design argument (task 464).
Hodkinson & Reynolds, 'Temporal Logic' (Handbook of Modal Logic, Ch. 11) — comprehensive survey of temporal-logic expressiveness and axiomatization (task 464).
Blackburn, de Rijke, Venema, Modal Logic (2002 Cambridge ed.) — model-theoretic and structural methods for the structure-first MPL argument (task 464). Note: blackburn_2001 tracks the same textbook.
